title: Nutlope/hallmark: a design skill that refuses the generated look
friendlyTitle: Hallmark: a design skill that tries not to look generated
summary: Hallmark was the most-starred AI-related repo on GitHub's daily trending list, with 2,235 stars today and about 35,900 in total. It is a design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode, made by Together AI, with 48 themes and a linter that checks a page at several widths.
friendlySummary: Hallmark was the most-starred AI-related repo on GitHub's daily trending list, with 2,235 stars today and about 35,900 in total. It is a design skill for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode, made by Together AI. It ships 48 themes and a checker that looks at a page at several screen widths.
whyItMatters: Install it with npx skills add nutlope/hallmark -g, then name it when you want a new page, an audit, or a redesign. It will not redesign a page that already exists unless you point at that page. The licence is MIT. The browser checks need Chrome. The static checks run without it.
